football-data.label: football-data.org — standings cross-check
football-data.note: Optional. Add a free FOOTBALL_DATA_KEY secret to enable an independent table check.

quotaNotes.fantasy.premierleague.com: No published quota; this site makes ~2 requests per 20 min plus ~30 after matches, spaced 400 ms apart.
quotaNotes.www.thesportsdb.com: Free tier: 30 requests/min; this site uses 2–3 per run every 1–6 h.
quotaNotes.api.football-data.org: Free tier: 10 requests/min (only if a key is configured).
quotaNotes.www.youtube.com: Public RSS feeds; 2–4 requests every 0.5–2 h.
quotaNotes.raw.githubusercontent.com / api.github.c: Community dataset: ~10 small files every 3 h (30 min after matches). GitHub API listing uses the workflow token (1,000 req/h).
